html:
Tungusic Tribes is the map's label for the Tungusic-speaking peoples of eastern Siberia and the Amur region around 1200. Most lived as hunters, fishers and reindeer herders in the taiga, such as the ancestors of the Evenks, Evens and Nanai.

Not all Tungusic peoples stayed in the forest. Their kin the Jurchens had built the Jin dynasty, which ruled north China from 1115 under the Jin, and later Jurchens, renamed Manchus, founded the Qing. Earlier maps show the same peoples as the Tungus.
